public_payload.normalized_proposition: The failures of GenAI image systems on left-handed requests come from poor language understanding, not from limited drawing ability.

statement.excerpt: Others of course found tortured prompts that did work, but those only go to show that the problem is not with GenAI’s drawing capacity but with its language understanding.
statement.document_title: Statistics versus Understanding: The Essence of What Ails Generative AI

our_interpretation: The claim concerns the left-handed drawing examples discussed on February 13, 2024, not every image-generation error.
Drawing capacity means the same model can render the requested handedness. Language understanding means correctly following the handedness specified in an ordinary prompt.

Successful alternative prompts can demonstrate rendering capacity, but identifying the cause of ordinary-prompt failures also requires separating language interpretation from sampling, visual preferences, and other pipeline effects.
criteria.support_condition: Repeated same-model comparisons establish successful rendering under equivalent reformulations and isolate incorrect interpretation of the ordinary handedness request as the cause of failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Controlled comparisons establish that the request is correctly interpreted but a rendering limitation causes the failure, or that the purported successful alternatives change the model or requested scene materially.
